SITE VISIT AND VERIFICATION OF INFORMATION The interested bidders have to visit the Works site to understand the job and ascertain for themselves the site conditions, local working conditions, local statutory rules and regulations under state government, loca l labour requirement and employment, location, surroundings, climate, applicable laws and regulations, an d any other matter considered relevant by them before submission of bid. Site visit is mandatory before s ubmission of bid. Bidders have to submit a certificate confirming to have visited the site and accept the ter ms and conditions as per enclosed Annexure VI, duly countersigned by HCL/MCP’s authorized representati ve (HOD of Department or his authorized representative) on the acceptance of the bidder. Site visit is man datory before submission of the bid otherwise your submitted offer will be rejected. 1. For this purpose, bidders shall communicate to HCL via e-mail indicating their intention to visit the site along with the intended date of visit and the details of their visiting representatives at least 3 (three) days before their intended visit. HCL shall communicate its response to the interested bidders who are planning to visit the work site at the earliest approving the date of visit or may specify another date as it may consi der suitable. 2. It shall be deemed that by submitting a bid, the bidder has complete understanding of the work and onl y after that the bidder has: a) Made a complete and careful examination of the bidding documents; b) Received all relevant information requested from HCL; c) Satisfied itself about all matters, things and information d) Acknowledged and agreed that inadequacy, lack of completeness or incorrectness of information provid ed in the bidding documents or ignorance of any of the matters shall not be a basis for any claim for comp

ensation, damages, extension of time for performance of its obligations, loss of profits etc. by the bidders f rom HCL, or a ground for termination of the Contract; e) Acknowledged that it does not have a Conflict of Interest; and f) Agreed to be bound by the undertakings provided by it under and in terms hereof. 3. HCL shall not be liable for any omission, mistake or error on the part of the bidder in respect of any of th e above or on account of any matter or thing arising out of or concerning or relating to tender, or the biddi ng process, including any error or mistake therein or in any information or data given by HCL. All expenses towards site visit shall be borne by the bidder. 4. In case of bidders who have already made their site visits, the site visit certificate for the previous corre sponding cancelled tender for the subject job, shall be acceptable. PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA, SCOPE OF WORK AND SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT 20. PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA 1. The bidder should have average minimum financial turnover of Rs.3.89 Lacs during preceding three years ending 31st March, 2026 (the proof of which is to be submitted along with the tender). 2. The bidder should have experience of having successfully completed similar work (AMC of CCTV setu p which includes CCTV Camera, NVR/DVR, and Display etc.) during last 7 years ending last date of mo nth prior to month of tendering (the proof of which is to be submitted along with the tender), should b e either of the following: a) Three similar completed works of value not less than Rs. 6.12 Lacs inclusive of GST each. or b) Two similar completed works of value not less than Rs. 7.65 Lacs inclusive o f GST each. or c) One similar completed work of value not less than Rs. 12.25 Lacs inclusive o f GST. 3. Similar work with respect to this tender means the vendor should have executed AMC of CCTV setup which includes CCTV Camera, NVR/DVR, and Display etc. to the Central/State Govt. organization/ PSU/ Company having Company Identificati on Number. (Documentary evidence is to be attached). Documents to be submi tted, PO copies along with Tax Invoice/CRAC/Completion Certificate. For arriving at cost of similar work, the value of work executed shall be brought to c urrent costing level by enhancing the actual value if work at simple rate of 7% (s even percent) per annum, calculated from the date of completion to the date of bid opening. 21. Special Terms & Conditions i. The vendor should have the capabilities to handle AMC for reputed brands and makes of CCTV Camera, DVR/NVR, Display and devices etc. ii. Bidder needs to submit Site-Visit certificate for technical qualification. The Site-visit certific ate must be obtained & submitted prior to the opening of Price Bids. iii. The Resident Engineer to be deputed for carrying out maintenance and repairs job will be required to p ossess degree/diploma/ITI in electronics/computer engineering/Computer Hardware/ Networking/CCTV Mai ntenance/COPA, with experience in customer support service as a CCTV setup service engineer.

21.SCOPE OF WORK: The successful vender shall maintain the equipment as mentioned above under “Comprehensive” Annual Maintenance. The comprehensive maintenance shall cover the maintenance of all the CCTV Camera, NVR, Switch, Display, UPS, cables, patch cords, accessories, Racks, CCTV network including OFC and CAT-6 cabl e replacement etc., as given in Table-1. Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract of CCTV based Surveillance System at HCL MCP will cover, t o keep it functional and ensuring deliverable outputs as per the system features highlighted and catering r equirement as per HCL MCP demand in effective and efficient manner during the period of CAMC. a) Maintaining of all items under AMC in good working condition. b) Replacement of all defective/worn out parts of equipment under AMC, replace the defective UTP cabl e, RJ45 Connector, HDMI/VGA Cable, Power Cable, patch cords, accessories, Racks, CCTV network incl uding OFC and CAT-6 cable replacement etc. c) Correcting/updating of VMS Software faults as and when reported. Updating of firmware/software/dri vers of CCTV Camera, NVR, computer and other devices used in the CCTV setup. d) Configuring the CCTV Camera, NVR, network switch if required i.e. connect through HCLMCP Lan net work. e) The party will attend all breakdown calls, as and when required, by the department for necessary rep airs, maintenance and attending breakdowns on priority within same working day. f) Maintaining of item wise record of maintenance activities (Replacement of part/repair, Preventive m aintenance etc.) carried out. HCL/MCP may seek these details as and when required. g) Resolving problems that may be encountered with regard to hardware, system software/device driv ers, firmware & software updates etc. and any problems in accessing the various CCTV applications o n the computer systems, etc. covered under AMC by giving necessary technical assistance and advice from time to time. h) Mandatory periodical/quarterly preventive maintenance (both breakdown & preventive), servicing of the all CCTV Camera and devices installed for the CCTV Surveillance setup (as given in Table-1). Quart erly preventive maintenance should be done by the Party as per schedule in AMC. i) Party should maintain the CCTV network of Optical Fiber Cable of approx. 6000 meters in normal wor king conditions so that all CCTV Camera and devices connected in network should be visible at control room and Security office. j) Any other action required for keeping the equipment under good working condition. k) The Party should provide comprehensive maintenance support to the equipment for Prime shift over age from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday to Saturday. If required party will have to provide support beyond normal working hours/days. l) The party will provide comprehensive support including repair and full replacement of spare sparts i ncluding plastic parts. m) The party should keep OFC Splicing Machine/OTDR machine etc. ready in Malanjkhand or nearby area so that in the case of OFC fault, repairing work should be started immediately. n) If resident engineer is on leave/absent, party has to provide suitable replacement immediately. o) AMC period will be commenced from the date of award of Work Order and valid for next 1year. p) Payments: 30 DAYS CREDIT after submission of Progressive Running Bill through E Payment after eve ry quarterly maintenance visit completion. Note -Evaluation Method - Overall Individual L1 basis. 21.2 MAINTENANCE COVERAGE a. Corrective Maintenance as and when required. b. The maintenance shall include checking, repair and replacement of parts, installatio n and configuration of software, firmware & software updates, CCTV Network mainte nance, including splicing of OFC cable it materials (like OFC Cable, patch cord, CAT-6 Cable, connectors, power extensions, MCB, JC Box etc). as per the scope of work/requ irement to keep the CCTV setup in working condition. 23 Preventive Maintenance: Preventive Maintenance of the hardware has to be carried out at lea st once in a quarter positively.

24 DEPLOYMENT OF ENGINEER a. TWO Resident Service engineers should be deputed at HCL/MCP b. Resident Engineer to be deputed for carrying out maintenance and repairs will be required to poss ess degree/diploma in electronics/computer engineering/Computer Hardware, Networking, CCTV wit h at least three years’ experience in customer support service as a resident engineer. c. Resident engineers will be provided accommodation at commercial rates as applicable depending upon the availability and electricity charges, water charges etc. will be charged separately as applic able. d. The Resident Service engineer provided by the contractor shall not be changed frequently. Howeve r, if found incompetent by HCL/MCP, then the resident service engineer shall be changed immediately by the contractor. e. Additional engineer may be deputed in addition to the resident engineers whenever there is more workload/complaints/emergency. No additional accommodation will be provided for these engineers. f. No transportation charges will be payable to the resident engineers by HCL/MCP. g. The party should keep tools like toolkit set, splicing machine, blower, LAN tester, punching tools et c. required for maintenance activities with each resident service engineer. h. If any resident engineer is on leave/absent, party has to provide suitable replacement immediately within 24 hours. 25.Special Terms & Conditions: i. PENALTY In case party has been failed to repair/ maintain the CCTV Surveillance system on normal working condition within 05 working days as per agreed terms and conditions, HCL/MCP reserves the ri ght to arrange the execution of the said work or part thereof through alternate sources at your risk an d cost and the difference in cost in additional cost, if any, shall be recovered from party. In addition to this, full penalty and liquidated damages will also be recovered from party. 26.CONTRACT PERIOD The Contract shall be for a period of Twelve months (12) from the date of issue of LOI/ Work Order. How ever, the contract can be extended for a further period of three months with the same rate, terms and con ditions at the discretion of HCL, MCP. 8. PERFORMANCE SECURITY (SECURITY DEPOSIT) 8.1 The successful Tenderer shall deposit an amount equivalent to 10% of the total C ontract/ Work Order value including GST. 8.2 Out of this, the initial Security Deposit will amount to 5% of the total Contract/ W ork Order value including GST. The Initial Security Deposit is to be deposited by the s uccessful Tenderer within 30 (Thirty) days from the date issue of Letter of Intent/Wor k Order, whichever is earlier, in the form of Insurance Security Bond/ /NEFT/RTGS/Fix ed Deposit Receipt/Bank Guarantee (on HCL’s format) from a Scheduled Commercial Bank except Co-operative and Gramin Bank for Goods/Services/Works/EPC Contracts. In case of Bank Guarantee, it has to be as per HCL’s prescribed format. 8.3 The Security Deposit equivalent to the balance 5% of the total Contract/ Work Or der value including GST will be recovered from the progressive bills of the contractor @10% from each RA Bill. However, after every six months, 50% of the accumulated r etention money can be refunded to the contractor against submission of equivalent a mount of Bank Guarantee (BG) from scheduled commercial bank. 8.4 HCL is at liberty, after having given fourteen (14) days written notice to the contr actor, to realize and/or for unsatisfactory performance of the contract or any clauses thereof.

8.5The above security amount shall remain fixed during the entire period of the cont ract irrespective of any decrease/increase in the value of contract due to any reason l ike increase/decrease in labour wages, price indices, change order, etc., during the e xecution of the contract. 8.6In case the Security Deposit is furnished by way of Bank Guarantee, it must be init ially valid for the entire contract period plus Defect Liability Period (DLP) plus 60 days beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations of the Contractor/contrac tor, including warranty obligations. 8.7A penal interest @18% per annum shall be collected from the bidders on a pro-rat a basis on account of any delay towards submission of SD/ Bank Guarantee amount a fter the assigned period of 30 days. 8.8 Only after submission of SD, the EMD of Successful Bidder will be refunded. 8.9 Payment of Contractor will be withheld until receipt of Performance Security/ Sec urity Deposit. 8.10 The bank A/C details for RTGS/NEFT payment are as under: IFSC Code: SBIN0004510 A/C Type: Current Account A/C No.: 11290757078 A/C Name: Hindustan Copper Limited 8.11 The method of submission of Bank Guarantee is as below: The bank guarantee issued by the issuing bank on behalf of the Contractor in favour of Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) shall be in hard copy in original on stamp paper a s well as Structured Financial Messaging System (SFMS). HCL has chosen State Bank of India to act advising/beneficiary bank of HCL. The ban k issuing the guarantee on behalf of the Contractor should choose this bank to send c onfirmation through SFMS. The details of beneficiary (i.e., HCL) for issue of bank guarantee through SFMS platfor m is as furnished below:

n Malanjkhand, Madhya Pradesh.” The Original Bank Guarantee issued by the outstation bank shall be sent by the Issui ng Bank to DGM (Mktg./M&C), Hindustan Copper Limited, Malanjkhand Copper Project at Malanjkhand, Pin code- 481116 by Speed Post/Registered Post. Any dues of the Company against the Contractor under the contract resultin g from award of work to some other agency at the risk and cost of the Contractor sha ll be adjustable against the security deposit and if SD is insufficient, the same shall b e recovered from the Contractor. · In case of termination of the contract by the Contractor, the Company shall have t he right to forfeit the Security Deposit. · On due and satisfactory performance and completion of the contract in all respect and settlement of final bills, the Security Deposit will be returned to the Contractor wi thout any interest on presentation of an absolute, No Demand Certificate in the form as may be prescribed by the Company. · In case of quantity enhancement/ repeat order as per Option Clause, time extensi on of SD provided for the original order shall be extended suitably by the Contractor to cover the extended period. In case the security deposited is not extended by the C ontractor at least one (01) month before its expiry then the same may be forfeited a nd encashed. The above claim period of at least one (01) month should be specificall y mentioned in the BG. · The Security deposit will be forfeited and credited to HCL’s account in the event of

a breach of contract by the contractor. Security deposit to be refunded to the contrac tor without interest, after successful performance and completion of the contract in al l respects but not later than 60 (sixty) days of completion of all obligations including t he warranty under the contract, subject to recovery of claim if any. · For service/works/EPC contracts having validity of more than two years, alternatel y, the security deposit for the entire amount may be initially submitted for eighteen ( 18) months and thereafter may be suitably extended on yearly basis until the end of the contract plus 60 days. In case the security deposited is not extended by the succ essful bidder at least one (01) month before its expiry of the same then the same ma y be forfeited and encashed.
